# Workplix

> Workplix is a multi-tenant workforce scheduling platform for businesses with hourly teams across one or more locations. It combines drag-and-drop shift scheduling, an AI scheduling assistant, time clock and attendance, time-off and shift-swap workflows, and real-time reporting.

Workplix helps managers build and adjust employee schedules faster by enforcing availability, time-off, and max-hours constraints automatically, and by letting managers make scheduling changes in plain English through an AI assistant.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://workplix.app/): Overview of features, pricing, and how the product works.
- [Sign up](https://workplix.app/signup): Start a free trial, no credit card required.
- [Log in](https://workplix.app/login): Access the scheduling dashboard.

## Key Features

- Drag-and-drop shift scheduling with automatic assignment
- AI scheduling assistant: create shifts and assign employees using natural language, with availability/time-off/max-hours constraints enforced automatically, and standing scheduling rules the assistant remembers
- Team management by branch and job role, with employee availability windows
- Time off requests and peer-to-peer shift swaps with approval workflows
- PIN-based kiosk time clock for attendance tracking
- Real-time reporting on hours worked and workforce metrics
- Multi-branch, multi-tenant support with role-based access
- Mobile app for employees to view schedules, request time off, and swap shifts

## Pricing

Two plans, billed per location: Starter and Growth, each with monthly and annual (20% discount) billing. Every plan includes a monthly allowance of AI assistant turns plus pay-as-you-go top-up credits that never expire. Free trial on every plan, no credit card required.
